item.name: Witchbane

effects.title: Cleanse
effects.text:
Dispel all enemies and allies in a 300 unit radius.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

effects.title: Subjugate
effects.text: Your attacks deal bonus magical damage equal to 4% of your target's Max Mana.

item.lore: With ready access to test subjects, untold cruelties have been dreamed up and loosed upon the world from within the walls of the Tyler Estate.
